title: Department Top Three Salaries
description: Find employees who earn the top three salaries in each department. If fewer than 3 employees in a department, return them all. Show department, employee name, and salary.
hints: Use DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY department_id ORDER BY salary DESC)
DENSE_RANK handles ties correctly (ties share the same rank)
Filter WHERE rank <= 3 in an outer query
